firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: h1 'See the spec before you choose' is 6 words, 2 lines, strong; city only in the mono kicker, not the h1; Compare floors primary + quieter Call secondary; phone in header. But the hero also carries the whole compare tool plus four chips plus a dark result chip and a third button, so LVP/BEST FIT shows twice in one view; the proof bar does not peek at 1440 (hero runs past 900px) (-0.5). 390-first.jpg: h1 2 lines, both actions above the fold, mobile call bar. No proof line under the h1.

distinctiveness.notes: Sample-chip system visible in hero (1440-first.jpg), services spec chips with layer swatches, the story cross-section (1440-scroll-25.jpg), cut-corner review cards (1440-scroll-75.jpg), estimator chip strip and footer TM chip (1440-rm-full.jpg). Drawn plank cutaway, RH probe and route map are not template parts. Deductions: mono micro-labels in every section (slop tell, -0.5); bone + terracotta palette sits close to sibling A's cream + rust (flooring/A 1440-first.jpg), C is clearly different.

type.notes: Archivo display tight and confident at h1 (1440-first.jpg), Karla body, DM Mono as concept accent. Scale contrast between h1 and mono spec lines works. Deduction: 4 tiny tracked caps labels in one hero view (FLOORING · ATLANTA, ROOM TYPE, PETS?, UNDER THE FLOOR) and BEST FIT twice (1440-first.jpg, -0.5). Mono sentence block in the story ('12 mil survives dogs.' etc., 1440-scroll-50.jpg) set centred in mono reads like code, not voice.

layout.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg: tones alternate paper / mid / light / deep / paper / light / mid / accent / deep / paper / light, no two darks touch except estimator(accent) into area(deep) which differ enough. Full-bleed plank cutaway is a real break and the asymmetric slab section works. Deductions: services is 10 near-identical chips (only #1 and #6 vary) and reviews 6 identical cards, two long uniform grids (-0.5); story band (1440-scroll-25.jpg / 1440-scroll-50.jpg) is a narrow centred column floating in a huge dark field; contact form (1440-rm-full.jpg bottom) is a 590px centred column with empty flanks at 1440.

photo.notes: No raster photos on the page (placeholders withdrawn); judged on the drawn treatments. 1440-rm-full.jpg: the edge-on plank cutaway with its four-swatch legend, the RH-probe drawing in the slab section and the Atlanta route sketch are on-topic, share one palette and read as one hand. Nothing blank or broken. Small stray triangle at the bottom-left corner of the plank band (1440-rm-full.jpg) is an artefact. No 9: none of the drawings move with scroll and the services chips' layer swatches are identical tiny icons.

copy.notes: Trade nouns throughout: wear layer, SPC core, RH probe, on grade, membrane (1440-scroll-50.jpg, 1440-scroll-75.jpg). Reviews and pricing labelled Sample. Deductions: primary action has several names: Compare floors / See best fit / See samples at your house (1440-first.jpg), Price it on every card (1440-scroll-25.jpg), Get a number for your project (1440-rm-full.jpg) (-0.5); arrow on every card link 'Price it ->' (1440-scroll-25.jpg). Story lines are slogan-like stubs.

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg: h1 2 lines, both actions above fold, sticky Call/Compare bar with thumb-sized targets, compare pills wrap cleanly. 390-rm-full.jpg: story stacks unpinned, plank cutaway re-cut with a stacked legend, reviews single column. render.json: no overflow at 320 or 390. Ten tall service chips make the services run very long on the phone.

a11y.notes: Reduced motion shows everything (1440-rm-full.jpg, 390-rm-full.jpg). Labels on every input, live regions present. mustFix: muted text fails contrast: service-card descriptions and contact lead in --muted #8C7B6E on #FAF8F5 / #F4EFE6 measure about 3.8:1 / 3.5:1 (1440-scroll-25.jpg, 1440-rm-full.jpg contact); footer is marked t-deep but renders on light bone, so its #B8A898-range text sits near 2:1 (1440-rm-full.jpg footer).

motion.notes: Hooks: hero compare tool updating the result chip (1440-first.jpg), pinned cross-section story (1440-scroll-25.jpg -> 1440-scroll-50.jpg), estimator chip strip filling with the slider (1440-rm-full.jpg), staggered chip entrances. Deduction: the story is the signature moment but between 25% and 50% the three layers only sit there with labels; the 'peel' that explains what 12 mil buys is not visible as a change in the frames (-0.5). 1440-full.jpg shows everything below the story unrevealed in a full-page capture: a stitching artefact, scroll frames confirm reveals fire.

wow.notes: 1440-first.jpg: the compare tool answers 'kitchen, pets, slab -> LVP, 12 mil wear, SPC core' in a dark chip in the signature's own language, with a plain-English reason. Paired with the slab checklist + RH probe drawing (1440-scroll-50.jpg) and the chip-strip estimator with a printable price (1440-rm-full.jpg). Tied to the thesis and something a homeowner would actually use. Not 10: the story itself is static-looking.

polish.notes: Consistent 2px-ish radii on chips and buttons, one rule weight, designed cut corners. Deductions: footer renders on light bone despite its deep tone and looks washed out, an undesigned close (1440-rm-full.jpg); pill radius on Sample badges and area tags next to square chips; stray triangle under the plank band (1440-rm-full.jpg).

mustFix.problem: Muted body text #8C7B6E on #FAF8F5/#F4EFE6 is about 3.5-3.8:1, under 4.5:1
mustFix.fix: Set --muted in .t-paper and .t-light to #6B5C50 (about 5.9:1 on paper) or darker

mustFix.problem: Footer is class t-deep but paints on light bone, so its muted links and legal text sit near 2:1
mustFix.fix: Give .footer background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink) so the t-deep tone actually paints #3B2218, or switch it to t-mid with --muted #5C4F44

elevate.move: Make the footer the deep close of the sample board: paint it #3B2218, set the TM chip, licence and nav as one spec strip in the chip language, and check every muted tone at 4.5:1 on its own band.

Split the hero into one statement and one tool: h1 with Atlanta in it and a proof line under it, then a single chip stack whose result chip IS the compare output, so BEST FIT appears once and the proof band peeks at 1440.
